# Ascentor

> Ascentor is a mentorship and leadership development platform for ambitious young Africans. Members join small Circles for accountability, work with human mentors, and use Sage, an AI coach, to build across six dimensions of life: Mind, Character, Vocation, Relationships, Community and Legacy. Ascentor is also home to The Elevation Summit, its annual gathering. Founded in Lagos, Nigeria by Posi Ajiboye.

Ascentor is not affiliated with Ascent, Ascentium, Ascend360 or other similarly named companies.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://joinascentor.com/): What Ascentor is and who it is for (Seekers, Builders, Leaders).
- [The Movement](https://joinascentor.com/movement): The ideology and the six-dimension "total person" model.
- [About](https://joinascentor.com/about): Mission, beliefs and founder Posi Ajiboye.
- [FAQ](https://joinascentor.com/faq): What Ascentor is, who it is for, and what a Circle and Sage are.

## The Elevation Summit

- [The Elevation Summit 2026](https://joinascentor.com/elevation-summit): Free one-day summit on 19 November 2026 at Aderemi Makanjuola Hall, Lagos State University, Lagos, with global virtual access. Theme: The Rise We Choose.
